notes: Summary table of general statistics by quadrangle for 1905; the three quadrangle columns are taken as the locations, the Total column as a summary. Per quadrangle 8 printed numbers: flowing wells, pumping plants, investment, estimated average output (second-feet), area irrigated, artesian area 1905, original artesian area, tillable land. Only the estimated average output was counted as a measured value (well_yield); the other 7 are in n_variables. Rules do not clearly cover an area-summary table: resolution set to no_time_series (inventory for one year), year 1905 from the table title. State from title 'southern California'.
